name: Poisson on a torus, tensor splines, preconditioner None
description:
Poisson equation on a full torus of minor radius 1 and major radius 4, comparing C1 polar
splines (IGAPolarTorus, no hole) with tensor-product splines on a torus with a hole (HollowTorus, a1=1e-2).
The manufactured solution is a Gaussian ring whose gradient is largest on the magnetic axis r=0.
Homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions are set at r=1 (boundary condition free at the hole).
The linear system is solved with CG, preconditioner None (poloidal solver schur).

fun.name: rhs_fun
fun.source:
def rhs_fun(x, y, z):
    return rhs_lam(x, y, z) + 0.0 * x
